newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vereinsbank ups Veba EPS 1996 forecast.
newsitem.headline: Vereinsbank ups Veba EPS 1996 forecast.

text.p: The research wing of Bayerische Vereinsbank said on Wednesday it was raising its 1996 EPS forecast for utility Veba AG to 5.10 marks from 4.80 marks after Veba's unexpectedly high nine-month figures.
Vereinsbank's utilities analyst Peter Antes said he was raising the 1997 EPS forecast for Veba, based on the DVFA method, to 5.40 marks from 5.35 marks.
Earlier, Veba reported a 25 percent increase in group net profit to 1.227 billion marks, above most analysts' expectations.
"These positive figures came as a surprise to most market players. The cold summer, combined with the company's ongoing cost reduction programme, boosted the earnings," said Antes.
